newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH, SLASKI SURGE ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: BPH, SLASKI SURGE ON THURSDAY.

text.p: Large cap banks BPH and Bank Slaski helped lead the Warsaw bourse's 2.7-percent jump on Thursday, up nearly 10 percent after recent deeper falls that made them attractive compared with the overall market.
"Banks such as Slaski and BRE had particularly fallen a lot and this is the reaction," one trader said.
BRE rose five percent in active trade on Thursday while Amerbank surged 9.9 percent in light trade.
Amerbank, BPH and BRE all saw strong buying after price fixing.
